Fixes: The one-time shop setup can no longer get stuck — devices upgrading from the online edition now open straight into their shop. Improves: The setup screen is clearer and friendlier, and PIN sign-in is smoother.

Fixes a problem where some shops could not open their saved products and sales after an update. Your data is kept. Sign-in screens are refreshed.

name: Counterbase Android 1.0.177
body:
## Counterbase Android Update

**Release:** Counterbase 1.0.177
**Internal build:** 2220
**Source:** GitHub Releases

### Download
- [GitHub Release](https://github.com/JohnHika/Jawaki-pos/releases/tag/v1.0.177-2220)

In-app update checks and downloads both use this GitHub release.

Pay several suppliers in one go from Finance. A short welcome for each person and a setup checklist for the owner. Expenses against daily sales, with cash expenses taken off the till at End of day. Cash given and change on receipts, which also show your location, phone and the customer. Customer statements as PDF, spreadsheet or message. Debt payments by cash, M-Pesa or bank. Fixes the Sell screen after saving a supplier bill.

name: Counterbase Android 1.0.178

**Source:** GitHub Releases

- [GitHub Release](https://github.com/JohnHika/Jawaki-pos/releases/tag/v1.0.178-2221)

In-app update checks and downloads both use this GitHub release.

Fixes from the Levisa Ventures phone check: real dates and receipt numbers in a customer's purchase history, the Record collection button no longer hidden on small screens, M-Pesa collections confirmed as payments, clearer wording when a customer pays part of a debt, and a tidier customer statement PDF.

Adding a carton or pack price to a product now starts with the unit Carton and asks how many pieces are in it. Before, it started with Copy. The product name example now reads Sugar 1kg.

Sign in a computer: on a computer, open Counterbase and choose Sign in with your phone. On this phone, open Settings, then Sign in a computer, and scan the code the computer shows. The computer opens your shop with your account, and no password is typed on it. Company codes now never contain a space: a space you type becomes a hyphen, so levisa ventures becomes levisa-ventures.

Your layout now stays put after you lock and unlock. A new look for Home, the price list and the bottom bar, with tablet and fold-phone layouts and a side-by-side Sell screen. Manage plan now lets you compare plans, upgrade, downgrade or cancel at renewal. Sign a computer in from your phone and see or sign out your linked computers. Fixes for the checkout that would not start.

Appearance settings: pick Small, Default or Large text and Compact or Comfortable spacing. The More menu is now a clean grid, Settings is calmer, cards are flatter, and you can ask for any layout change, not just a listed business type.

A simpler bottom bar: Home, Sell, Products and More, with the AI assistant and Settings at the top of More. Asking for a layout change now starts with your reason, and Send tells you what is missing. Layout actions, Payments and other screens are calmer and easier to scan. Sign-in shows your business logo straight away on repeat visits.

name: Counterbase Android 1.0.188

In-app update checks and downloads both use this GitHub release.

Your computer now shows which phone signed it in. Add your KRA PIN under Tax and KRA PIN, and choose whether it prints on receipts (off unless you turn it on). Payments shows the money received today, including what customers paid toward debts, by cash, M-Pesa and bank. Products has a Products and Stock switch, a search icon and a plus icon in the header. Debt Replies, Appearance and Settings are calmer and easier to scan. The AI assistant shows the Axon mark with an AI tag.

The Back button now takes you to the screen you came from instead of closing the app. New Store room for shops that keep stock in a back room: receive stock into the store, bring it to the shelf and keep count. Bookshop tools: special orders with deposits, school book lists and sale or return. Computers get a Back arrow and mouse-back support. Sales checks now warn the owner if they cannot run.

Adds a link to Your account on Plan & Billing. Shops more than 7 days late on a setup payment pause new sales and records (viewing and paying stay open).
